STORY SO FAR: Tue 08-11, ON THE PLANE. First flight boarded, he opened with 'any words?' and got the send-off session: the era-turn named (countdown drops at touchdown, the field mission stops being the session's output and becomes its input, the table sets the pace), the campaign meter in one breath, one gift word, three fires in the order he will live the first hour on the ground.

THREE FOR THREE, COLD, UNAIDED, FIRST ASK. Nothing named in any prompt except the situation. (1) Airport pre-paid taxi counter, he wants the damage before committing: EVLO AAGUM? -- a deck item that had NEVER been in his mouth (production none). The 08-09 watch item 'Evlo Rubai?' is answered: handed a scene where the verb was the only way out, he produced the verb. (2) Car slowing at the junction, her street on the right, driver needs to swing in and not carry on: VALADHU PAKKAM THIRUMBUNGA -- and this is the one that matters, because on 08-10 the identical shape got 'valadhu pakkam PONGA', a working substitute I explicitly refused to count as the deck item. Today the deck item itself, with the verb. (3) Amma at the door, warm and fast and long, he catches two words: INNORU THADAVA SOLLUNGA -- the antifreeze reflex, not an English apology, not a fake nod. SURVIVAL 29 -> 32/34. Two survival lines left in the whole tier: ஆமா ஆமா and முடிஞ்சா.

THE FINDING OF THE DAY, AND HE FOUND IT AGAIN HIMSELF: right after firing all three he asked 'what does thirumbunga mean.' He produced a four-part chunk cold WITHOUT OWNING ONE OF ITS PARTS. Three of the four are his -- வலது is cold, பக்கம் he has (the paakkalaam collision, 07-27), -ங்க is a cold machine -- and திரும்பு had never appeared anywhere in the lexicon. Checked before answering, so no repeat of the 08-09 error: this one genuinely was NOT hiding inside something he owns. It is the mirror image of chunk-not-machine: there he re-used a whole chunk under pressure instead of swapping the slot; here he fired the chunk correctly and then went looking for the slot on his own, unprompted. The 08-09 standing instruction ('ask him what he already has, far more often') is now running in the other direction -- he is doing his own inventory. That is the habit worth protecting; it is worth more than the three fires.

TAUGHT: திரும்பு -- turn / turn around, and its second and more useful job in country, திரும்பி வாங்க (come back). Contrast beat with 08-10's substitute: போங்க sends the car onward, திரும்புங்க turns it. One clause, no re-teach.

வந்துட்டேன் IS SEEN ONLY, NOT FIRED. Given as the gift word with the inventory carve -- வரேன் is his (கை கழுவிட்டு வரேன்), and the -இட்டு/-ட்டு completive tail is already COLD in frame:done-ittu, sitting inside விட்டுடு / பழகிப்போச்சு / ஆயிடுச்சு. வந்தேன் reports the journey; வந்துட்டேன் says the coming is finished. I wrote it above his head, so it does not get counted -- the honest test is the doorstep. THAT IS THE FIELD MISSION and it is the last one of the old era: வந்துட்டேன் at that door, out loud, first thing.

STUDIO IS DOWN ON THIS MACHINE -- the negative-la episode order stands UNPRODUCED after three attempts. Cloud container has no agy writer, and render_audio dies on a cryptography rust-binding panic (pyo3 PanicException) before it reaches TTS. Told him plainly; nothing retries it (watchdog retired 07-24). No loss for the flight -- M86 plus the three long-hauls and M74_v2 are already loaded. The புரியல-for-reopen test still has nowhere to live until that dose gets built on a working machine.

STILL OPEN: chunk-not-machine (n=1, and today cuts against it). english-word-order 2x, NOT closed -- today's three were memorised chunks, not built sentences, so they are not evidence either way. Volley frozen at 2/4; this morning's volley 2/4 (auto driver missed the turn) was never answered in the channel, but its exact content fired here instead. Delight still 5 cold of 27; three zinger items never worked. Field mission from 08-10 (propose with -laamaa at dinner/packing night) NEVER COLLECTED -- he did not answer the ask. Collect it on the ground. ERA TURNS AT TOUCHDOWN: countdown and burn rate leave the status line, the mission becomes the input, never narrate a deficit in country.

soak_order.scene_seed: an errand where nothing works: the shop is shut, the phone will not connect, nobody can remember the man's name -- every beat is a different verb failing, and the person telling it is enjoying the disaster far too much
soak_order.focus: the -ல negative as ONE MACHINE under chunks he already fires whole. He owns புரியல and முடியல as separate memorised chunks and has never heard the -ல as a part. Make the tail audible across verbs he owns -- புரியல, முடியல, தெரியல, கேட்கல, பண்ணல, வரல -- so the swap is the payload and the words are its output; same treatment the -லாம் tail just got in M86. Also carve புரியல's conversational JOB, not just its shape: it CLOSES the exchange ('I don't understand', give up) where என்ன சொன்னீங்க? REOPENS it -- he owns the giving-up line and not the keep-going line, and that test has been owed for weeks.
